Inversion with fronted negative words ·: Negative or semi-negative adverbs at the start of a sentence require partial inversion.本课为情景运用练习,核心:Never/Hardly/Not only + auxiliary + subject + base form。

Never have I seen such a beautiful place.|Hardly had I arrived when it began to rain.|Not only did we lose, but we also got hurt.|Little did he know the truth.|the negative adverb determines the use of the auxiliary
Never have I seen such a beautiful sunset.
column3: 我从未见过这么美的日落。
